subject: Geography
question: Assertion (A): Wind-patterns are clockwise in the northern hemisphere, and counter- clockwise in the southern shell. Reason (R): The direction of wind patterns in northern and southern hemisphere is determined by the Coriolis effect. Code :
options: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are correct but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
Assertion (A) is correct but Reason (R) is incorrect
Assertion (A) is false but Reason (R) is correct
explanation: Generally, prevailing winds blow east-west rather than north-south. This happens because Earth's rotation generates what is known as the Coriolis effect. This effect makes wind systems twist clockwise in the Northern Hemisphere and anticlockwise in the Southern Hemisphere.
source: (IAS (Pre) G.S. 2005) MPPSC (Pre) GS 2008 · Indian & World Geography GS p.330

subject: Geography
question: What causes wind to deflect towards left in the Southern hemisphere?
explanation: Our planet's rotation produces a force on all bodies moving relative to the Earth. Due to Earth's approximately spherical shape, this force is greatest at the poles and least at the Equator. The force, called the ‘Coriolis effect’, causes the direction of winds and ocean currents to be deflected. In the Northern Hemisphere, wind and currents are deflected towards the right, in the Southern Hemisphere they are deflected to the left.
source: (IAS (Pre) G.S. 2010) · Indian & World Geography GS p.330

question: Consider the following statements about the Roaring Forties: 1. They blow uninterrupted in the Northern and Southern Hemispheres 2. They blow with great strength and consistency 3. subject: Geography
question: Warm wind that flows in the Alps region of Europe, is known as–
explanation: Warm and dry wind that flows in the Alps region of Europe, is known as Foehn. Chinook is warm and dry wind which blows to the eastern side of Rocky mountain situated in USA and Canada in winter season. This helps in melting of ice in that region. Hence it is also called as snow eater. Sirocco blows from Sahara desert to Italy. It is warm wind. Bora is cold wind which blows near Adriatic sea.
source: UPPSC ACF-RFO Main I Paper 2019 · Indian & World Geography GS p.332

subject: Geography
question: Find out the correct sequence of planetary winds found from the equator to pole.
explanation: Trade winds, Westerlies, Polar winds is the correct answer Trade winds – they originate from north east at 25o to 30° in northern hemisphere and from south east in southern hemisphere at 25–30° towards equator and also from southeast towards equator Westerlies – They originate from horse latitude towards poles i.e. at 30 to 60 degree latitude Easterlies or Polarwinds – They originate from high pressure poles towards low pressure westerlies. So, from the Equator towards the Poles, the sequential order of the wind is Trade winds, Westerlies and Polar winds
source: MPSC 2017 · Indian & World Geography GS p.332

question: Bora winds blow in region.
explanation: Bora, originally is defined as a very strong cold wind that blows from the northeast to the Adriatic sea region of Italy, Slovenia, and Croatia.

It sometimes attains hurricane force at the mouth of the Taku River, after which it is named. Santa Ana: A strong, hot, dry wind blowing out into San Pedro Channel from the southern California desert through Santa Ana Pass Mistral: Strong, cold, northwesterly wind blowing from the north over the northern coast of the Mediterranean Sea, particularly over the Gulf of Lions. subject: Geography
question: Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer using the codes given below the Lists : List-I List-II (A) Belt of calm (1) G.G. Coriolis (B) Deflective force (2) Doctor (C) Roaring forties (3) Equatorial (D) Harmattan (4) Westerlies Codes : A B C D
explanation: Belt of calm- Known to sailors around the world as the doldrums, the Inter-Tropical Convergence Zone or the belt of calm is a belt around the Earth extending approximately five degrees north and south of the equator. Deflective force or the Coriolis Force also called Coriolis effect, is an inertial force described by Gustave-Gaspard Coriolis. It is a deflective force due to which the circulating air in the earth's atmosphere is deflected towards the right in the Northern Hemisphere and towards the left in the Southern Hemisphere. Roaring forties are strong westerly winds found in the Southern Hemisphere, generally between the latitudes of 40°S and 50°S. Harmattan is a cool dry wind that blows from the northeast or east in the western Sahara.It is also known as the "doctor wind", because of its invigorating dryness compared with humid tropical air of the Gulf of Guinea.
source: Arunachal PSC (GS) 26-11-2021 · Indian & World Geography GS p.333

question: Consider the following statements: 1. Jet streams occur in the Northern Hemisphere only 2. Only some cyclones develop an eye. 3. The temperature inside the eye of a cyclone is nearly 10ºC lesser than that of the surroundings. Which of the statement given above is/are correct?
explanation: Jet streams are fast narrow meandering air currents present in atmosphere (Troposphere). Jet streams are present in North and South hemisphere about 8 to 15 km above sea level. The eye of a cyclone is a region of mostly calm weather found at the centre of strong tropical cyclone. Temperature inside eye of cyclone is more than 28o C. Cyclone can be weak if temperature is less than required. Only tropical cyclones have eyes.

subject: Geography
question: Doldrums is zone of
explanation: ITCZ ( Intertropical Convergence Zone) is caused by the convergence of northeast and southeast trade wind in the area encircling earth near the equator. The ITCZ is also known as Doldrum Zone or calm zone. The doldrums is a popular nautical term that refers to the belt around the earth near the equator where sailing ships sometimes get stuck on windless waters.
source: RPPSC 2012 · Indian & World Geography GS p.334

subject: Geography
question: Dew does not form in the night with strong winds, because -
explanation: The dew is not formed on the windy night, because the winds blow fast resulting in high evaporation rate and the moist air does not come into contact with cold objects for longer time to get cooled. Hence the condensation does not take place and no dew can be formed. World Geography
source: BPSC (Pre) 1995 · Indian & World Geography GS p.334

subject: Geography
question: Assertion (A): Relative humidity is more in winter than in summer. Reason (R): With the increase in temperature, the water holding capacity of air increases.
options: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
(A) and (R) are both true but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
explanation: Relative humidity is the ratio of amount of water vapour held by an air of definite volume and temperature to its maximum holding capacity. Relative humidity is a concept based on temperature, geomorphological structures and slopes and hence may never be solely decided on basis of summer and winter. Hence, assertion is wrong. But with increase in temperature, the water holding capacity of air increases. Hence option (d) is correct.
source: U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) G.S. 2001 · Indian & World Geography GS p.334

subject: Geography
question: The heat released at the time of condensation is called as
explanation: The heat released at the time of condensation is called as Latent heat. Latent heat (also known as latent energy, or Heat of Transformation) is energy released or absorbed, by a body or a thermodynamic system, during a constant-temperature process — usually a first-order phase transition.

subject: Geography
question: Read the following statements and choose the correct option: (i) Moving away from the sea, force of tropical cyclone decreases. (ii) Tropical cyclone gets its energy from release of latent heat on account of condensation of moisture that wind gathers after moving over the ocean which decreases as it move away from sea.
options: (i) and (ii) both are true, and (ii) is correct reasoning of (i)
(i) and (ii) both are true, but (ii) is not correct reasoning of (i)
explanation: Tropical cyclones gets its energy from the release of latent heat on account of condensation of moisture that it gathers while moving over the ocean. Therefore, as it moves away from the sea its energy weakens which results into reduced force of the tropical cyclone. Hence, both the statements are correct and statement (ii) is correct reasoning of statement (i).
source: CGPSC Pre 2022 · Indian & World Geography GS p.336

subject: Geography
question: Which of the following statement(s) is (are) incorrect? 1. Cyclones are usually associated with belts of rain, clouds and snow whereas anticyclones are generally free from precipitation. 2. Cyclones are violent storms characterized by high wind rotating around a calm centre of low atmospheric pressure. 3. The lifespan of a tropical cyclone may vary from one to three weeks.
explanation: Cyclones are usually associated with belts of rain, clouds and snow whereas anticyclones are generally free from precipitation. Cyclones are violent storms characterized by high wind rotating around a calm center of low atmospheric pressure. The life cycle may run their course in as little as a day or can last as long as a month. The longest-lasting tropical cyclone ever observed was Hurricane/Typhoon, which existed for 31 days as it traveled 13,000 km (8,1000 mile) path from the eastern pacific to the western Pacific and back to the central Pacific. Hence only statement 3 is incorrect.
source: Gujrat PSC 2018 · Indian & World Geography GS p.336

question: For the purpose of reducing wind forces on the roof during a cyclone, the best roof architecture of a building, out of the options below is

On its way it uproots everything. Pyramidal Roofs:- • Pyramids are made of Triangles. Triangles in construction are considered the strongest shape. • A pyramid roof is a sort of hip roof with four triangle-shaped sides that all slope downhill. • The pyramid roof is particularly sturdy due to its unique design, especially against the wind because the area of attack is so tiny. • Pyramidal roof is appropriate for reducing wind force during a cyclone.

Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false

explanation: A cyclone is any low-pressure area with winds spiraling inwards. Cyclones rotate anti-clockwise in Northern Hemisphere and rotate clockwise in Southern Hemisphere. question: As per Koppen's climate classification, which among the following are correctly matched? (A) Cwg - Bharatpur (B) Bwhw - Barmer (C) Bshw - Ganganagar (D) Aw-Dungarpur
explanation: Climatic types as per Koppen's scheme- Cwg-(Monsoon type with dry winters) - It includes most part of Gangetic Plain, Eastern Rajasthan (Tonk, Bundi, Ajmer, Sawai Madhopur, Bhilwara, Chittorgarh, Kota, Bharatpur) Assam and in Malwa Plateau. Aw-(Tropical Savannah type) - Southern most part of Rajasthan (Banswara and Dungarpur Districts) and Most part of peninsular Plateau barring Coromandel and Malabar Coastal strips. Bwhw-(hot desert type) - Most of Western Rajasthan such as North-Western Jodhpur, Jaisalmer, Western Bikaner and western part of Ganganagar district. Bshw-(Semi-arid with dry winter) - Some rain shadow areas of Western Ghats, large Part of Rajasthan and contiguous parts of Haryana and Gujarat. In Rajasthan, it is found in districts of Barmer, Jalore, Jodhpur, Nagaur, Churu, Sikar, Jhunjhunu and Hanumangarh. Therefore only option A and D are correctly matched.
source: RPSC (RAS) (PRE.) 2021 · Indian & World Geography GS p.340

question: Two statements are given below, one is called Assertion (A) and the another is reason (R) Assertion (A): Areas near the equator receive rainfall throughout the year. Reason (R): High temperatures and high humidity cause convectional rain in most afternoons near the equator. In the context of the above two statements, which one of the following is correct?
options: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not a correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
explanation: High temperature is found near equator throughout the year due to which the surface is overheated causing vertical winds. As the surface winds rise, they spread and become cold and reaching at higher altitude they get saturated. This is followed by condensation of water vapour and rain. This process frees the latent heat which forces the air there to rise by reheating, causing more rain. In this way, the regions adjacent to the equator receive rainfall throughout the year due to the elevation of hot and humid air to higher altitudes. Thus the statement A and Reason R both are true and R is correct explanation of A.
source: (IAS (Pre) G.S. 1996) · Indian & World Geography GS p.341

question: The world's most drought-prone country is -
explanation: Australia is the driest continent in the world. The major reasons for it being drought prone are as follows: (1) Cold currents off the west coast (little evaporation to form rain clouds) (2) Great Dividing Range (running down the east coast prevents rain from penetrating far inland). (3) Few mountains to force air upwards where it can cool into rain but the region being dominated by the sub-tropical high pressure belt, that warms and dries the air. (4) El-Nino- Southern Oscillation. (5) Overgrazing and Ground water sources ( aquifers) depletion. World Geography

question: Read the following sentences and select the correct answer from the codes given below— Assertion-(A): There is no rainfall in mediterranean region during summers. Reason-(R): Trade winds do not flow over this region during summers. Codes :
options: A and R both are true and R is correct explanation to A
A and R both are true but R is not correct explanation of A World Geography
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
explanation: Mediterranean regions experience dry Summers and wet winters due to shifting of wind belts in these seasons. In winters ITCZ shift southwards, so westerlies also shifts southwards covering Mediterranean regions. Coming from west they pick up moisture from Pacific/Atlanatic/mediterranean, and precipitates in mediterranean regions. In summers, ITCZ shifts to north of Africa thereby westerlies pushes north to Northern Europe region. Now North-west trade winds occupy the mediterranean regions coming from north east interior continental regions. Thus trade winds lack moisture and hence there will be almost no precipitation in summers.
source: U.P.P.C.S. (Pre) G.S., 2005 · Indian & World Geography GS p.345

explanation: Coral reefs are the most diverse of all marine ecosystems. Coral reefs are predominantly present in tropical shallow waters less than 50 meters deep. Global distribution of corals- Australia-17%, Indonesia-16%, Philippines-9%. So, Australia, Indonesia and Philippines together host more than one-third of world’s corals. So, statement 1 and 2 are correct. These tropical marine communities occupy less than 1% of the ocean floor, but are inhabited by at least 25% of all marine species. Scientists estimate that more than 25,000 described species from thirty-two of the world’s thirty-three animal phyla live in reef habitats – four times the number of animal phyla found in tropical rain forests. Due to this reason they are often called the rainforests of the sea. So, Statement 3 is correct.

subject: Geography
question: Coral Bleaching is associated with removal of:

But when the ocean environment gets too hot, for instance—the coral stresses out and expels the algae. As the algae leaves, the coral fades which looks like it’s been bleached. If the temperature stays high, the coral won’t let the algae back, and the coral will die. Coral reefs are found in tropical sea's between 30°N to 30°S. They require temperature of 20°C-25°C for growth.

subject: Geography
question: With reference to the United Nations Convention on the Law of Sea, consider the following statements: 1. A coastal state has the right to establish the breadth of its territorial sea up to a limit not exceeding 12 nautical miles, measured from baseline determined in accordance with the convention. 2. Ships of all states, whether coastal or land-locked, enjoy the right of innocent passage through the territorial sea. 3. The Exclusive Economic Zone shall not extend beyond 200 nautical miles from the baseline from which the breadth of the territorial sea is measured. Which of the statements given above are correct?
explanation: According to Article 3 under section 2 of United Nations Conventions (UNCLOS) regarding the territorial limits of the sea, every state has the right to establish the breadth of its territorial sea up to a limit not exceeding 12 nautical miles, measured from baselines determined in accordance with this Convention. Hence, Statement 1 is correct. According to Article 17 under section 3 of United nations conventions (UNCLOS), ships of all States, whether coastal or land-locked, enjoy the right of innocent passage through the territorial sea. Hence, Statement 2 is correct. The 1982 United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) defines an Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ). It is an area that shall not extend beyond 200 nautical miles from the baselines. The EEZ is measured from the breadth of the territorial sea. Hence, Statement 3 is correct. Hence, option (d) is the correct answer.
source: UPSC IAS 2022 · Indian & World Geography GS p.391
